content.comment_body: Dear Expert, We are looking to replace our [product_name] with display, article number [article_no]. After checking, it appears this product has been phased out, with its successor [article_no] also discontinued. Is it possible to use [article_no] as a replacement? Additionally, can this controller connect with our old expansion module ([article_no])? Please advise.

You can substitute [article_no] with [article_no], but the expansion module will not work on the [article_no]. The contact slider on the expansion module uses different coding, and the bus system in the [article_no] is incompatible with previous hardware. To resolve this, replace the module with article number [article_no] instead of [article_no].
Hi, Is it possible to order the phased-out [product_name] as a spare part? This should be an option.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face issues replacing discontinued [product_name] controllers due to incompatibility with legacy expansion modules, largely because of changes in hardware such as bus systems and coding. This friction arises from expectations of easy upgrades and backward compatibility, but confusion remains over the availability and compatibility of replacement parts.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect new replacement controllers to be compatible with existing expansion modules and hope that spare versions of recently discontinued [product_name] modules will remain available.
